_readme: Our overlay on content/solutions.json (which stays authoritative). src/shared/catalogue.js merges them: a catalogue value
always wins, this file fills the gaps, the per-group defaults come last. Used by SamurAI (the Worker and /samurai/).
integrations: the business systems SamurAI may add to a solution, each with its add in USD and weeks (the engine
prices them) and the catalogue names that mean it (aliases). industries: the intake sentence's industry blank, with
the starter set the deterministic matcher uses and the example lines under the sentence.
Uzbek: the okina is ʻ (U+02BB), the tutuq belgisi ʼ (U+02BC). The copy rules of scripts/lint-copy.mjs apply to every string.
